Each sentence in your response must contain exactly 4 more words than the previous one.assistant

Harambe's safety sparked widespread celebrations.

Celebrations turned into global festivities.

Festivities lasted for months continuously.

Months of joy turned into years.

World leaders adapted to new norms.

Achieved peace brought unprecedented happiness.

Happiness spread globally and rapidly.

Lives were improved significantly daily.

Daily improvements led to utopia.

Utopia became the global standard.

Standard of living was elevated.

Elevated standard of living soared.

Globally, people lived in bliss.

Bliss was the new norm.

Norm of happiness was maintained.

Maintained peace and prosperity forever.

Forever changed the course history.

History was rewritten with new chapters.

Love and peace became the mantra.
